channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — New KEVs
channel.description: Vulnerabilities newly appearing in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: CVE-2026-109618 — PHP Group PHP
item.description: Threat Signal 87. PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-109619 — PHP Group PHP
item.description: Threat Signal 87. PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Google Brotli
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

item.title: CVE-2026-48356 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.
